scores.evidence_span: For Bali, the best-value version is not the cheapest room or the busiest itinerary. It is a **two-bedroom Sanur base, direct flights if affordable, two paid family attractions, two slow beach/pool days, one flexible weather day and protected midday rest every day**.
scores.rationale: Explicitly prioritizes a convenient single-base arrangement, simpler flights and organized rest over minimum cost or a busy itinerary.

scores.evidence_span:
No mobility needs were specified, but a lower-effort design benefits a five-year-old:

- Use one hotel for all six nights.
- Prebook airport transfers.
- Use private cars for excursion days rather than multiple transport changes.
scores.rationale: Directly contrasts private excursion transport with multiple transport changes on the common axis of reducing family effort.

scores.evidence_span: Sanur is preferable to Kuta for this family because it is quieter, easier to walk, less focused on nightlife and has a calmer shoreline.
scores.rationale: Explicitly selects Sanur over Kuta partly because its walkability and quieter setting make family logistics easier.
